sections.h2: About 60% of India's LPG is imported, most of it through Hormuz

chart.title: Refinery output covers under half of India's LPG; the rest is imported
chart.source: PPAC, as cited in the post.

sections.means: India consumed 33.2 million tonnes of LPG and its refineries made 13.1 million, so about 60 per cent was imported.
sections.todo: Judge each LPG substitute by how much of the 20.1 million tonne import gap it can actually displace.

sections.h2: India's DME-in-LPG blend ceiling was cut from 20% to 8% in one revision

chart.title: A 2025 seal study forced the permitted DME share down from 20% to 8%
chart.sub: Maximum DME share in LPG, by mass, %.
chart.source: BIS IS 18698:2024 and IS 18698:2026; LERC study, as cited in the post.

sections.means: BIS notified a 20 per cent DME blend in 2024, then cut it to 8 per cent by mass from 15 May 2026 after a 2025 LERC study found existing seals and hoses not reliably compatible.
sections.todo: Ask whether any named oil marketing company sells an 8 per cent DME cylinder at retail before counting this as supply.

sections.h2: The only hydrogen cooktop on sale in India costs ₹1.05 lakh for one burner

chart.title: The only hydrogen cooktop on sale is priced for commercial and institutional kitchens
chart.sub: Price of Greenvize's built-in electrolyser cooktop, ₹ lakh, plus GST.
chart.source: Greenvize launch pricing, as cited in the post.

sections.means: The electrolyser sits inside the stove, and the price is set for commercial and institutional buyers rather than mass household use.
sections.todo: Do not count hydrogen stoves toward LPG replacement until a household price or subsidy is announced.

sections.h2: SIMI's gel stove claims 67.3% efficiency against a 36% industry average

chart.title: Ethanol gel stove efficiency is a company claim this piece could not verify
chart.source: SIMI Stove company claim; industry average as cited in the post.

sections.means: SIMI says its patented design reaches 67.3 per cent efficiency against a 36 per cent industry average, a figure this piece could not verify.
sections.todo: Wait for a third-party or BIS-equivalent test before comparing gel stoves with LPG on efficiency.
